title: An offer invoiced to a company outside the CRM no longer loses its invoice
text: When an offer says "Invoice to" a company that is not in the CRM yet, the company is saved as the payer and put on the invoice. The live database was refusing that save, so a client signing such an offer would have had a signed contract and no invoice. It is now accepted. If an invoice ever cannot be created at signing, it also shows in System Health instead of only in a log. Offers invoiced to a person or to a company already in the CRM are unchanged.
